title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Training Note — First-Dispute Courtesy on a Settled Invoice Dispute
content:
**What is the first-dispute courtesy?** When a business's approved invoice dispute on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account is its only invoice dispute in the past 24 whole calendar months, the dispute settlement credit includes a first-dispute courtesy. Its rate depends on the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership.

**How is "only invoice dispute" read?** The invoice dispute requests filed on the account in the 24 whole calendar months counted back from the date the credit is posted are counted, whatever their status. When that count is no more than one, the approved dispute is treated as the only one; when two or more were filed in the window, another dispute was filed and the courtesy is zero.

**What rate applies?**

| Invoice disputes filed on the account in the 24-month window | The business's active Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership | First-dispute courtesy rate |
|---|---|---|
| No more than one | ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum or ProBuild Platinum Elite | 2 percent |
| No more than one | No Gold or higher membership (ProBuild Member, Bronze or Silver, or no active membership) | 1 percent |
| Two or more | Any | Zero |

**How is the courtesy computed?** The first-dispute courtesy is the disputed amount times the first-dispute courtesy rate, divided by one hundred. It enters the dispute settlement credit unrounded; the credit is rounded to the nearest cent on its total.

**Worked cases (hypothetical, disputed amount 640.00)**

- One dispute filed in the window, active ProBuild Platinum Elite: 640.00 times 2, divided by one hundred, is 12.80.
- One dispute filed in the window, active ProBuild Silver: 6.40.
- One dispute filed in the window, no ProBuild membership: 6.40.
- Two disputes filed in the window, active ProBuild Gold: zero.
